summary: The bill requires the Coast Guard, within one year, to launch a four-year pilot program establishing a Cetacean Desk inside the San Francisco Vessel Traffic Service that monitors large whales via existing and emerging data sources, shares real-time sightings with vessel operators, implements local traffic rules, and trains mariners to reduce strikes and disturbances in the Bay and Golden Gate.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a new 4-year pilot program creating a Cetacean Desk within the Coast Guard's San Francisco Vessel Traffic Service, requiring up to 2 full-time equivalent positions plus potential technology adoption and data-sharing infrastructure. This constitutes a modest expansion of federal operational spending and staffing.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, credits, or revenue measures.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare delivery, insurance, or medical services.
The bill contains no provisions related to firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
The bill contains no provisions related to immigration, visas, border security, or refugee policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to reproductive rights or abortion access.

Although the Coast Guard is involved, the bill addresses civilian vessel traffic management for marine mammal protection and does not alter military or defense budgets, procurement, or force structure.

The core purpose is to reduce vessel strikes and disturbances on large cetaceans through monitoring, real-time alerts, speed/buffer zones, and emerging detection technologies. This directly expands federal environmental protection efforts for marine mammals.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs, food assistance, or social safety-net benefits.
The bill contains no provisions related to schools, student aid, or education policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to controlled substances or drug enforcement.
The bill contains no provisions related to sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
The bill contains no provisions related to tariffs, trade agreements, or import/export policy.
The bill authorizes a small, time-limited pilot program but does not address deficit reduction, debt ceiling, or long-term fiscal policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign assistance or international aid.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting rights, election administration, or campaign finance.
The bill encourages adoption of AI and data-integration technologies solely for cetacean detection and vessel coordination; it does not regulate private-sector data practices or privacy rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to collective bargaining, worker protections, or union rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or anti-discrimination law.
